[T3 Code: the agent in T3 thread "9b581f9e-99f2-4346-8611-1ad1fdba6dd5" sent this message, not the user.]

Act as the implementation sub-agent for this task.

You are implementing PR 6 (the last) of a stacked series in Moneo. Follow AGENTS.md exactly (no comments, test rules, QA backend only — never the owner's backend or port 3000; migrations per "Database changes", must work in the desktop bundle without pg_cron etc.; new data folders/storage must be covered by desktop backup/restore; Speed section; screenshots embedded in the PR).

Stacking: `git fetch origin`, create branch `t3/settings-6-logs` from `origin/t3/settings-5-diagnostics` (PR #345 → #344 → #343 → #342 → #341). Open your PR with base `t3/settings-5-diagnostics`. PR 5 built `/settings/diagnostics` (reachable only from Settings) with section chips (Usage, Health) and an `ai_usage` ledger written through one helper that every model must use. Add a "Logs" section/chip there.

Owner's requirement (their words, condensed): Moneo is open source; when someone has a problem they should see the logs directly and troubleshoot or share them with us. Store logs of EVERYTHING that happens while using the app:
- server errors and warnings (the ~30 `console.error`/`console.warn` sites in app/, lib/, workflows/ should go through one logger that both prints and stores), client errors in the browser (error boundaries, unhandled rejections, failed fetches) sent to a local endpoint, background jobs/workflows (start, stage, finish, error), bank and Scalable syncs, imports, scheduler/cron runs,
- every AI interaction: chat requests and replies INCLUDING the model's thinking/reasoning, tool calls and results, agent runs, organizer decisions, artifacts — link to the `ai_usage` row,
- voice: voice-call audio (both sides if available), text-to-speech output audio, and speech-to-text input audio (the audio file itself) with the transcript.
Audio goes to the existing Storage service (bucket, RLS per workspace), text/events to a log table (new migration, `lib/schema.ts`, `npm run db:types` on the test backend). Logging must never block or slow the user's action (fire-and-forget with a named failure handler per lint rules) — measure chat time-to-first-token and a page open before/after.

Retention: a setting on the Logs section (and saved like other settings via the workspace settings Zod schema — a stored value this version can't read must never block sign-in): 1 week, 14 days (DEFAULT), 30 days, 90 days, Forever. A daily job (`lib/scheduler.ts` / `cronRoute()`, or the existing daily maintenance if any) deletes text logs and audio older than the setting — test the cutoff math with the owner's time zone. "Reset all data" clears logs and audio. Logs are NOT readable by the AI chat (no read scope).

Logs UI on Diagnostics: newest first, filter by level (error/warn/info), area (AI, voice, sync, import, jobs, app/server, browser) and time; search text; expand an entry to see details (JSON), its linked conversation/run/usage row, and an audio player for audio entries; paging/virtualization so thousands of entries stay fast. "Copy for a bug report" (and "Download" as a .txt/.json file) for the current filtered selection, with REDACTION: money amounts, IBANs/account numbers, names of people/merchants/accounts, emails, API keys/tokens/secrets, and audio excluded — show a preview of exactly what will be copied. Put redaction in a pure `lib/` function with thorough tests (that's real behaviour: leaked IBAN/key = bug). Also a "Delete all logs now" action with confirmation.

Hit every surface: FEATURES.md (`npm run feature-map`), README (what is logged, where it's stored, retention, how to share for a bug report — note it stays on the owner's machine), `.env.example` only if a new variable is needed (avoid), desktop backup/restore if storage layout changes, privacy (`npm run check:privacy`). Mobile, light and dark.

Workflow: commit in steps, messages end with `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`. Mock AI/bank/Scalable in tests; seed logs (including a short synthetic TTS-like audio clip, no real voice) on QA for screenshots and remove after. Before/after screenshots (skill `verify-ui`) light/dark/mobile: Diagnostics before, Logs list, an expanded AI entry with thinking, an audio entry with player, the redaction preview, the retention setting. Run `npm test`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build`, `npm run check:bundle`, `npm run test:db`, affected Playwright. Push, open PR titled "Diagnostics: logs of everything with audio and a retention setting", screenshots uploaded so they render (as earlier PRs did on the `pr-assets` branch), Speed and Decisions sections, body ends with "🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)". If something can't be captured (e.g. browser-only voice audio), open a GitHub issue and list it. Do not merge. Final line: PR <full URL>, head <SHA>, checks and reviews <state>.
